sentences.en: Eric Molenski has reported a few episodes for us over the years,
sentences.zh: 埃里克·莫伦斯基（Eric Molenski）多年来为我们报道过几期节目，

sentences.en: and he has his own great podcast called Imaginary Worlds that we've featured a couple of times.
sentences.zh: 他自己也有一档很棒的播客叫《虚构世界》（Imaginary Worlds），我们曾多次推荐过。

sentences.en: Imaginary Worlds has a very special place in my heart because
sentences.zh: 《虚构世界》在我心中有着非常特殊的地位，因为

sentences.en: it is the podcast I listen to the most with my boys, Maslow and Carver,
sentences.zh: 它是我和我的孩子们——马斯洛（Maslow）和卡弗（Carver）——听得最多的播客，

sentences.en: because it covers all the sci-fi and fantasy subjects that they love, like
sentences.zh: 因为它涵盖了他们喜爱的所有科幻和奇幻主题，比如

sentences.en: D&D and Doctor Who and LARPing in a really thoughtful and entertaining way.
sentences.zh: 《龙与地下城》（D&D）、《神秘博士》（Doctor Who）以及实境角色扮演（LARPing），而且内容既深刻又有趣。

sentences.en: And like every great show, it's about those things,
sentences.zh: 就像每一档优秀的节目一样，它不仅是在谈论这些事物，

sentences.en: but it's really about who we are as humans through these worlds that we create and share.
sentences.zh: 更是在通过我们创造和分享的这些世界，探讨作为人类的我们究竟是谁。

sentences.en: Now, earlier this year, Imaginary Worlds produced a story about the thing that is most
sentences.zh: 今年早些时候，《虚构世界》制作了一期关于我孩子们最

sentences.en: near and dear to my boys' hearts, and that's the card game, Magic the Gathering.
sentences.zh: 心爱之物的节目，那就是卡牌游戏《万智牌》（Magic: The Gathering）。

sentences.en: I just called magic a card game, but if you spend any time around someone who loves magic,
sentences.zh: 我刚才管《万智牌》叫卡牌游戏，但如果你和任何热爱《万智牌》的人待过，

sentences.en: you know it is way more than a card game.
sentences.zh: 你就会知道它远不止是一款卡牌游戏。

sentences.en: It is a way of life.
I'm pretty sure it rewired my son's brains.
sentences.zh: 我敢肯定它重塑了我儿子的思维方式。

sentences.en: I've wanted to cover Magic on 99PI for a while now, but Eric did such a great job with it,
sentences.zh: 我一直想在《99%隐形》里聊聊《万智牌》，但埃里克做得太出色了，

sentences.en: it made more sense to share his version and introduce you to another great podcast
sentences.zh: 分享他的版本，并向大家介绍另一个你们可能还不知道的优秀播客，

sentences.en: that you might not know already.
You're listening to Imaginary Worlds, a show about how we create them
sentences.zh: 你正在收听的是《虚构世界》，一档关于我们如何创造世界

sentences.en: and why we suspend our disbelief.
sentences.zh: 以及为何要暂停怀疑（进入虚构世界）的节目。

sentences.en: Hello, my name is Nat Neal Bale.
sentences.zh: 你好，我叫纳特·尼尔·贝尔（Nat Neal Bale）。

sentences.en: Nat is teaching me how to play Magic the Gathering at the Brooklyn Strategist,
sentences.zh: 纳特正在“布鲁克林战略家”（Brooklyn Strategist）教我玩《万智牌》，

sentences.en: which is the same game shop where I learned to play Dungeons & Dragons a few years ago.
sentences.zh: 那也是几年前我学习玩《龙与地下城》的同一家游戏店。

sentences.en: But where D&D is a role-playing game, magic is very much a card game.
sentences.zh: 但《龙与地下城》是角色扮演游戏，而《万智牌》则是不折不扣的卡牌游戏。

sentences.en: And by the way, magic is the shorthand that most people call Magic the Gathering,
sentences.zh: 顺便说一下，“万智牌”（Magic）是大多数人对《万智牌》（Magic: The Gathering）的简称，

sentences.en: so I'm going to mostly call it magic in this episode.
sentences.zh: 所以这期节目里我大多会直接称它为“万智牌”。

sentences.en: At the simplest level, there are two basic types of cards in Magic, lands and spells.
sentences.zh: 从最基础的层面来看，《万智牌》里有两种基本卡牌：地牌和咒语牌。

sentences.en: In some ways, Magic is like any card game.
sentences.zh: 在某些方面，《万智牌》就像任何卡牌游戏一样。

sentences.en: You need a combination of luck and skill to win, and it's usually played with just two people.
sentences.zh: 你需要运气和技巧的结合才能获胜，而且通常是两人对战。

sentences.en: But it is not a generic deck of cards.
sentences.zh: 但它不是一副普通的扑克牌。

sentences.en: Each of the cards has a creature or a spell or a magical artifact on it
sentences.zh: 每一张牌上都有一个生物、咒语或魔法神器，

sentences.en: that you can use to attack your opponent.
sentences.zh: 你可以用它们来攻击对手。

sentences.en: And some cards represent the source of your magic, which are lands.
sentences.zh: 有些牌代表你魔法的来源，也就是地牌。

sentences.en: The more land cards that you have, the more magic you can wield against the person sitting across from you.
sentences.zh: 你拥有的地牌越多，你能对坐在对面的人施展的魔法就越强大。

sentences.en: And your goal is to knock your opponent from 20 points to 0 points.
sentences.zh: 你的目标是将对手的生命值从20点降至0点。

sentences.en: So when you play, you always have seven cards in your hand that you're taking from a deck of 60 cards.
sentences.zh: 所以当你玩的时候，你总是从60张牌的牌库中抽取7张牌在手中。

sentences.en: Well, that deck of 60 cards is something that you custom make.
sentences.zh: 嗯，那60张牌的牌库是你自己定制的。

sentences.en: Because the company that makes Magic the Gathering, Wizards of the Coast,
sentences.zh: 因为《万智牌》的制作公司——威世智（Wizards of the Coast），

sentences.en: has put out over 10,000 possible cards to choose from over the last quarter century.
sentences.zh: 在过去四分之一个世纪里，已经推出了超过10,000种可供选择的卡牌。

sentences.en: And there is a central mythology that unites those thousands and thousands of cards.
sentences.zh: 而且有一个核心神话将这成千上万张卡牌联系在一起。

sentences.en: Because Magic the Gathering takes place in a multiverse.
sentences.zh: 因为《万智牌》的故事发生在一个多元宇宙中。

sentences.en: And some of the cards represent planewalkers, the main characters of the game,
sentences.zh: 有些卡牌代表“鹏洛客”（Planeswalkers），也就是游戏的主角，

sentences.en: who can jump from one parallel universe to another.
sentences.zh: 他们可以从一个平行宇宙跳跃到另一个平行宇宙。

sentences.en: Now, I always knew that Magic the Gathering was huge.
sentences.zh: 我一直都知道《万智牌》非常火。

sentences.en: But I had never done an episode about it because I was kind of intimidated.
sentences.zh: 但我从未做过关于它的节目，因为我有点被它吓到了。

sentences.en: Like, when I used to go to the Brooklyn Strategist to play D&D,
sentences.zh: 比如，以前我去“布鲁克林战略家”玩《龙与地下城》时，

sentences.en: we'd all be role-playing our characters like we were in some kind of medieval improv troupe.
sentences.zh: 我们都会像在中世纪即兴表演剧团里一样扮演我们的角色。

sentences.en: And then I'd look at the table where these people were playing Magic the Gathering,
sentences.zh: 然后我会看向旁边那些玩《万智牌》的人的桌子，

sentences.en: and it was like they were speaking a whole other language.
sentences.zh: 感觉他们好像在说一种完全不同的语言。

sentences.en: Now, this year is the 25th anniversary of Magic the Gathering.
sentences.zh: 今年是《万智牌》诞生25周年。

sentences.en: And it amazes me the game is still so popular.
sentences.zh: 这款游戏至今仍如此受欢迎，这让我感到惊讶。

sentences.en: Not that there's anything wrong with the game itself,
sentences.zh: 并不是说游戏本身有什么问题，

sentences.en: but, I mean, it was developed by this mathematician named Richard Garfield in the early 90s.
sentences.zh: 我是说，它是由一位名叫理查德·加菲尔德（Richard Garfield）的数学家在90年代初开发的。

sentences.en: And there was very little competition from video games.
sentences.zh: 当时电子游戏带来的竞争还非常小。

sentences.en: And now so many analog games and toys that used to be pretty solid
sentences.zh: 而现在，许多曾经非常稳固的模拟游戏和玩具，

sentences.en: are struggling to compete against PlayStations and iPad apps.
sentences.zh: 都在努力与PlayStation和iPad应用竞争。

sentences.en: And Magic does have an app, but the handheld card game is still the main focus.
sentences.zh: 《万智牌》确实也有应用，但实体卡牌游戏仍然是核心重点。

sentences.en: And they are not struggling to compete.
sentences.zh: 而且他们并没有在竞争中挣扎。

sentences.en: I mean, Magic the Gathering has been on an epic run where each year is more profitable than the laSt.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，《万智牌》一直处于史诗般的增长中，每年的利润都比上一年更高。

sentences.en: So I had two questions about the game I was really curious about.
sentences.zh: 所以我对这款游戏有两个非常好奇的问题。

sentences.en: First, why has it survived the onslaught of digital entertainment?
sentences.zh: 首先，它为何能在数字娱乐的冲击下幸存下来？

sentences.en: And secondly, how do you create a sense of story and world-building in a non-sequential card game?
sentences.zh: 其次，你如何在非线性的卡牌游戏中创造故事感和世界观？

sentences.en: And does all that mythology and world-building make for a better card game?
sentences.zh: 所有这些神话和世界观构建会让游戏变得更好吗？

sentences.en: Or is it something the players ignore when they just focus on winning?
sentences.zh: 还是说玩家在专注于获胜时会忽略这些？

sentences.en: Well, to answer those questions, I went straight to the top
sentences.zh: 为了回答这些问题，我直接找到了最高层，

sentences.en: to the head designer for Magic the Gathering, Mark Rosewater.
sentences.zh: 《万智牌》的首席设计师马克·罗沃特（Mark Rosewater）。

sentences.en: I'm pulling out of the driveway.
We all know what that means.
sentences.zh: 我们都知道这意味着什么。

sentences.en: It's time for another drive to work.
sentences.zh: 又到了“开车去上班”（Drive to Work）的时间了。

sentences.en: By the way, that is how he starts every episode of his podcast
sentences.zh: 顺便说一下，这就是他每期播客的开场白，

sentences.en: as he drives to the office outside Seattle, talking about different aspects of the game.
sentences.zh: 他在开车去西雅图郊外办公室的路上，谈论游戏的各个方面。

sentences.en: And he doesn't just do a podcaSt.
Mark is out there on every media platform, talking about Magic, answering questions from players.
sentences.zh: 马克活跃在每一个媒体平台上，谈论《万智牌》，回答玩家的问题。

sentences.en: He is a force of personality.
sentences.zh: 他是一个极具个人魅力的人。

sentences.en: Now, Mark has been with the company since the mid-90s,
sentences.zh: 马克从90年代中期就在这家公司工作了，

sentences.en: just a few years after Magic the Gathering came out.
sentences.zh: 就在《万智牌》推出几年后。

sentences.en: And I have to say, in all of my years of interviewing people,
sentences.zh: 我必须说，在我采访过的人中，

sentences.en: I don't think I've ever met anybody who so unabashedly loves their job as much as Mark does.
sentences.zh: 我想我从未见过像马克这样毫不掩饰地热爱自己工作的人。

sentences.en: My job is to come up with really cool things that will make players really, really excited.
sentences.zh: 我的工作是构思出非常酷的东西，让玩家感到非常、非常兴奋。

sentences.en: And then I have to not talk about it for 16 to 24 months, usually.
sentences.zh: 然后我通常得在16到24个月内对此守口如瓶。

sentences.en: For example, last December, we put out a product called Unstable,
sentences.zh: 例如，去年12月，我们发布了一款名为《Unstable》的产品，

sentences.en: which is kind of like a humorous take on Magic.
sentences.zh: 这算是《万智牌》的一种幽默版本。

sentences.en: I've been working on this project for seven years,
sentences.zh: 我为这个项目工作了七年，

sentences.en: and I had to not talk about it for seven years.
sentences.zh: 而且我必须守口如瓶七年。

sentences.en: And so when I finally got to talk about it, people are like, wow, you're so excited.
sentences.zh: 所以当我终于能谈论它时，人们说，哇，你太兴奋了。

sentences.en: I'm like, I've been waiting to talk about it for seven years.
sentences.zh: 我说，我已经等了七年才谈论它。

sentences.en: Now, one of the reasons why Magic has stayed popular all these years is because the game never stops evolving.
sentences.zh: 《万智牌》多年来保持受欢迎的原因之一，就是游戏从未停止进化。

sentences.en: As I mentioned earlier, the premise of the game is that there are these parallel universes called planes.
sentences.zh: 正如我之前提到的，游戏的前提是存在被称为“时空”（planes）的平行宇宙。

sentences.en: And the frequency in which Wizards of the Coast has introduced these new planes
sentences.zh: 而威世智引入这些新时空的频率，

sentences.en: has gone from every couple of years to every year to now sometimes twice a year.
sentences.zh: 已经从每几年一次，变成每年一次，现在有时一年两次。

sentences.en: And, you know, in the beginning, Magic was relying on all the standard fantasy tropes
sentences.zh: 你知道，起初《万智牌》依赖于所有标准的奇幻套路，

sentences.en: that you would see in a game like Dungeons & Dragons.
sentences.zh: 就像你在《龙与地下城》这类游戏中看到的那样。

sentences.en: But as they kept introducing new worlds more and more quickly,
sentences.zh: 但随着他们越来越快地引入新世界，

sentences.en: they kind of ran out of those fantasy tropes.
sentences.zh: 他们有点用完了那些奇幻套路。

sentences.en: And so they've also had to be more creative in terms of what they bring into the fantasy genre.
sentences.zh: 所以他们必须在引入奇幻题材方面更具创造力。

sentences.en: Like in one of these parallel universes, everything's made of metal.
sentences.zh: 比如在其中一个平行宇宙里，一切都是金属做的。

sentences.en: Or another one of these parallel planes is like a steampunk version of India.
sentences.zh: 或者另一个平行时空就像是蒸汽朋克版的印度。

sentences.en: A set of cards is a very challenging way to tell a story.
sentences.zh: “一套卡牌是一种非常有挑战性的叙事方式。”

sentences.en: Not everybody sees every card and they don't see them in the same order.
sentences.zh: 并非每个人都能看到每一张牌，而且他们看到的顺序也不一样。

sentences.en: So what we've done is we tend to use our cards to build the environment,
sentences.zh: “所以我们所做的是，倾向于利用卡牌来构建环境，

sentences.en: to build the world, to flesh out the world, and hint at the story.
sentences.zh: 构建世界，充实世界，并暗示故事。”

sentences.en: And then we tend to tell the story through other means.
sentences.zh: “然后我们倾向于通过其他方式来讲述故事。”

sentences.en: Like on the Magic the Gathering website,
sentences.zh: 比如在《万智牌》的官网上，

sentences.en: there's a lot of extra material explaining what is going on in these different worlds.
sentences.zh: 有很多额外资料解释这些不同世界中正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: But eventually they decided to up the ante on the design of the cards.
sentences.zh: 但最终他们决定在卡牌设计上加大投入。

sentences.en: So when you encounter a new deck,
sentences.zh: 所以当你遇到一副新牌组时，

sentences.en: you automatically feel something about this world
sentences.zh: 你无需阅读背后的背景故事，

sentences.en: without having to read the backstory behind it.
sentences.zh: 就能自动对这个世界产生某种感觉。

sentences.en: We want to figure out what the emotional core of the experience is going to be.
sentences.zh: “我们想找出这种体验的情感核心是什么。”

sentences.en: That the mechanics aren't just about doing something,
they're about making you feel something.
sentences.zh: 它们是为了让你感受到某种东西。”

sentences.en: And it really got into the idea of,
sentences.zh: “它真的深入到了这个理念中：

sentences.en: we're going to go to a gothic horror world,
sentences.zh: 我们要去一个哥特式恐怖世界，

sentences.en: and we're going to make you afraid because it's a gothic horror world.
sentences.zh: 我们要让你感到恐惧，因为这是一个哥特式恐怖世界。”

sentences.en: Or we're going to go to a Greek mythology world,
sentences.zh: “或者我们要去一个希腊神话世界，

sentences.en: and you're going to be a hero and go on adventures and make something of yourself.
sentences.zh: 你将成为一名英雄，去冒险并成就一番事业。”

sentences.en: Now, there are three basic elements to each card.
sentences.zh: 现在，每张卡牌都有三个基本要素。

sentences.en: First, there's an illustration, which is about two by two inches.
sentences.zh: 首先是插画，大约是2乘2英寸大小。

sentences.en: But there's so much drama and story going on in those little paintings.
sentences.zh: 但在那些小画作中，蕴含着如此多的戏剧性和故事。

sentences.en: I mean, looking at them, I get sucked in like it's a movie.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，看着它们，我会被吸引进去，就像在看电影一样。

sentences.en: The second element to every card is the statistics
sentences.zh: 每张卡牌的第二个要素是数据，

sentences.en: as to how this creature or spell or artifact will function as a card.
sentences.zh: 即这个生物、咒语或神器作为一张牌将如何运作。

sentences.en: And I did not realize how many different ways a card could behave in a game.
sentences.zh: 我以前没意识到一张牌在游戏中可以有这么多不同的表现方式。

sentences.en: I mean, it is endless in terms of how many points you gain or take away from your opponent,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在你能获得或扣除对手多少点生命值方面，它是无穷无尽的，

sentences.en: whether this card is better used on the offensive or the defensive,
sentences.zh: 这张牌是更适合进攻还是防守，

sentences.en: how many times you can use the card.
sentences.zh: 你可以使用这张牌多少次。

sentences.en: And the game mechanics aren't random.
sentences.zh: 而且游戏机制不是随机的。

sentences.en: They reflect the personality of what's on the card.
sentences.zh: 它们反映了卡牌上所描述事物的个性。

sentences.en: And the third major element to every card is something called flavor text,
sentences.zh: 每张卡牌的第三个主要要素是所谓的“风味文字”（flavor text），

sentences.en: which are basically a few lines of poetic description.
sentences.zh: 基本上就是几行诗意的描述。

sentences.en: But even the flavor text has gotten more ambitious over the years,
sentences.zh: 但即使是风味文字，多年来也变得越来越有野心，

sentences.en: not in terms of how many words they can cram into a card,
sentences.zh: 不是指他们能在卡牌上塞进多少字，

sentences.en: but how succinctly they can paint a picture of a broad story beyond that one card.
sentences.zh: 而是指他们能多简洁地描绘出那张牌之外的宏大故事。

sentences.en: Back when I used to write flavor text, one of the things was it was a lot like poetry.
sentences.zh: “以前我写风味文字时，其中一点是它非常像诗歌。”

sentences.en: It was a lot like how can I convey as much as possible in the smallest amount of space.
sentences.zh: “它很像是在问：我如何在最小的空间内传达尽可能多的信息。”

sentences.en: And one of my favorite pieces of flavor text,
there's a card in a set called, we went to this icy world.
sentences.zh: 在一个系列里有一张牌，我们去了这个冰冷的世界。”
那个系列叫《冰雪时代》（Ice Age）。

sentences.en: And there was a card in it called Lurgoyf, which was this horrible monster,
sentences.zh: 里面有一张牌叫“Lurgoyf”，那是一个可怕的怪物，

sentences.en: loosely based on some Norse stuff.
sentences.zh: 大致基于一些北欧元素。

sentences.en: The flavor text on it was,
Ak Han's run, it's for Lurgoyf.
sentences.zh: 阿克·汉的奔袭，这是给卢格夫用的。

sentences.en: Last words of Safi Ereg's daughter.
sentences.zh: 萨菲·埃雷格女儿的遗言。

sentences.en: And somehow just like this idea that this poor woman,
sentences.zh: 不知为何，这种想法让我觉得这个可怜的女人，

sentences.en: that like the last thing we learn about her is she's scared to death
sentences.zh: 我们关于她最后了解到的事情，就是她吓得要死，

sentences.en: because she knows how horrible this creature is.
sentences.zh: 因为她知道这个生物有多么可怕。

sentences.en: And she is right because that's the last thing she ever says.
sentences.zh: 她是正确的，因为那也是她说的最后一句话。

sentences.en: And as much as Mark loves to talk about the game,
